Validation.targetMustBeUnknown: The target quantity must be unknown and cannot have a given value.
Validation.signMismatch: Displacement and velocity have opposite directions, which would imply negative time.
Validation.indeterminateTime: When velocity and displacement are both zero, duration is indeterminate.
Validation.indeterminateVelocity: When elapsed time and displacement are both zero, velocity is indeterminate.
Validation.impossibleStationaryDisplacement: An object with zero velocity cannot undergo non-zero displacement.
Validation.impossibleZeroDurationDisplacement: An object cannot travel non-zero displacement in zero duration.
